verdict.rationale: Open-source availability is a fair question for marketing-automation software, since open-source alternatives exist in this category, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence pack shows HubSpot Marketing Hub's source being published under an open license. The pack covers only proprietary SaaS features, APIs, documentation probes and an MCP server, none of which concern source availability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can read the product's source under an open license
